name: bm25
description:
Okapi BM25 of each text for a query: one score per text, rounded to 4 decimals.

Terms are the lemmas without stopwords, on both sides; a term repeated in the query counts once. A word without a lemma (a single letter, an abbreviation or a unit: «г», «руб», «см») is no term. The length of a text is its number of terms. idf = ln((N - df + 0.5) / (df + 0.5) + 1); N, df and the average length are taken over the given texts, so to rank my text among the competitors give all of them together. score = sum over the terms of idf x tf x (k1 + 1) / (tf + k1 x (1 - b + b x length / average length)). A text without a term of the query scores 0.
query: the query, a phrase.
k1: how fast the score of a term saturates with its count (usually 1.2..2).
b: how much the length of a text lowers the score, 0..1 (0: not at all).

Example: semkit read texts.csv bm25 "угловой диван" write -
-> Диван угловой и кресло. Купить диван недорого., 0.8806; Кресло и диван, диван кожаный., 0.2784

The step takes each cell of the working column as a text and writes its score for the query to a new column <column>_bm25; to rank my text among the competitors, put all the texts in the working column.

options.name: --k1
options.description: how fast the score of a term saturates with its count (usually 1.2..2).

options.name: -b
options.description: how much the length of a text lowers the score, 0..1 (0: not at all).

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.

arguments.name: QUERY
arguments.description: the query, a phrase. The same as --query QUERY.
